name: bash
arguments:
{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
billing='''record_id,quantity,unit_price,shipping
CUS-001,28,63.66,74
CUS-002,40,55.6,62
CUS-003,72,30.9,24
CUS-004,16,11.51,53
CUS-005,34,64.0,43
CUS-006,55,60.08,66
CUS-007,37,65.85,19
CUS-008,66,36.68,62
CUS-009,40,15.6,44
CUS-010,53,22.76,34
'''
disc=Decimal('0.0837'); tax=Decimal('0.0673')
rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(billing)))
t=Decimal('0')
for r in rows:
    raw=Decimal(r['quantity'])*Decimal(r['unit_price'])*(Decimal(1)-disc)*(Decimal(1)+tax)+Decimal(r['shipping'])
    amt=raw.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    t+=amt
    print(r['record_id'], raw, amt)
print(len(rows),t)
PY"}
